title: Bram and the Thorn Revisited
author: G. M. Amberdale
blurb: Edmund Montrose, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
